rules.title: Multi-stage builds
rules.text: Use multi-stage builds and slim base images with pinned versions.

rules.title: Run as non-root
rules.text: Run containers as a non-root user.

rules.title: Layer caching
rules.text: Order Dockerfile instructions for layer caching: dependencies before source.

rules.title: .dockerignore
rules.text: Maintain a .dockerignore to keep secrets and build context small.

rules.title: Health checks
rules.text: Define health checks and handle SIGTERM for graceful stop.

rules.title: Pin base images
rules.text: Pin base images to a version or digest and rebuild regularly for patches.

rules.title: No secrets in images
rules.text: Never bake secrets into images or build args; use build secrets or runtime injection.

rules.title: One concern per container
rules.text: Run one main process per container.

rules.title: Compose for local dev
rules.text: Define local dependencies in docker compose with named volumes and healthchecks.

rules.title: Exec form entrypoints
rules.text: Use the exec form for ENTRYPOINT and CMD so signals reach the process.
